steps: Immediately before copying, repeat the Gradle/Android Studio process check and lsof +D on the exact source. Stop if a process or open handle appears; confirm Gradle is not needed offline and destination has sufficient free space.
Copy to a unique external staging directory with macOS ditto options that preserve mode, ACLs, extended attributes, and resource forks. Keep the source untouched and authoritative during this copy.

Compare a complete relative-path manifest, entry types, file count, logical sizes, permissions, owner/group, timestamps, content hashes, ACL listing and extended attributes between source and staged tree. Abort without swap on any discrepancy.

After a complete match and a second no-open-handle/daemon check, atomically rename the original directory to a same-parent dated backup, create the stable ~/.gradle/caches symlink to the unique external copy, and verify the symlink and content. Before deleting only that exact backup, recheck that it still matches the preserved external copy and is not open. Remove it with a safe exact-path Python operation; never use broad rm/force.

If validation fails after swap, stop Gradle, verify the symlink points to this exact external target, remove only that symlink, and rename the dated backup to ~/.gradle/caches. Keep the external copy.
